remarks: Welcome to this stunning 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath townhome in Stamford's sought after Ainslie Square community. Offering nearly 2,000 sq ft of modern living space, this home features an open concept layout with hardwood floors, a gourmet kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, and an abundance of natural light. Community amenities include a clubhouse, fitness center, swimming pool, playground, and beautifully landscaped grounds. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Stamford, shops, restaurants, and the Glenbrook Train Station, this property is perfect for commuters and those seeking a vibrant lifestyle. Don't miss the opportunity to make it your next home!
